title: Meetings Vocabulary: Agenda, Minutes, Attendees
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el vocabulario clave para organizar y participar en reuniones corporativas en inglés.

parts.visual: Agenda: La lista de temas a tratar (NO es una agenda de papel para fechas, eso es un diary/planner). Attendee: Asistente (persona que va a la reunión). Host/Chair: Quien dirige la reunión.
parts.audio: Agenda is the list of topics to discuss. It is NOT a diary or planner. Attendee is a person who goes to the meeting. Host or Chair is the person who runs the meeting.

parts.visual: Minutes: El acta de la reunión (resumen escrito de lo acordado). To schedule / set up: Agendar. To postpone / put off: Postponer. To cancel / call off: Cancelar. Action points: Tareas asignadas al final.
parts.audio: Minutes is the written summary of the meeting. To schedule or set up means to organize. To postpone or put off. To cancel or call off. Action points are tasks assigned at the end.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta de vocabulario de reuniones.

questions.question: Please send the ____ before the meeting. (Lista de temas).
questions.explanation: Agenda = lista de temas a discutir.

questions.question: Who is taking the ____? (Escribir el acta/resumen).
questions.explanation: Take the minutes = redactar el acta.

questions.question: There are ten ____ in this meeting. (Asistentes).
questions.explanation: Attendee = asistente a una reunión o evento.

questions.question: John is the ____ of today's meeting. (Quien la dirige/Preside).
We need to ____ a meeting for next week. (Agendar/Organizar).
The client is sick, so the meeting is ____. (Cancelada).
Let's review the ____ points from yesterday. (Tareas a realizar).
questions.explanation: Action points = tareas asignadas / plan de acción.

questions.question: Could you ____ an invitation to the team? (Enviar).
questions.explanation: Send an invitation = enviar una invitación.

questions.question: The first ____ on the agenda is the budget. (Tema/Punto).
questions.explanation: Item on the agenda = punto de la agenda.

questions.question: Let's ____ down to business. (Ir al grano / empezar a trabajar).
questions.explanation: Get down to business = empezar a trabajar en el tema.

questions.question: A ____ is a formal meeting in a company. (Junta/Reunión).
questions.explanation: Board meeting = junta directiva / reunión de la junta.

questions.question: Who is ____ the meeting today? (Dirigiendo - otra forma de decirlo).
questions.explanation: Running a meeting = dirigir una reunión.

questions.question: Please ____ the meeting on your calendar. (Anotar/Agendar).
questions.explanation: Save the meeting (o put it in your calendar).

questions.question: We need a ____ room for 10 people. (Sala de reuniones).
Please read the ____ before we start. (Documentos/Materiales).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de vocabulario correcta.

questions.question: Send the ____ before the meeting. (Lista de temas).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please send the agenda before the meeting.
options: Please send the agenda before the meeting.
Please send the minutes before the meeting.
Please read the agenda before the meeting.
Please check the agenda before the meeting.
questions.correct_answer: Please send the agenda before the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There are ten attendees in this meeting.
options: There are ten attendees in this meeting.
There are five attendees in this meeting.
There are ten people in this meeting.
There are ten assistants in this meeting.
questions.correct_answer: There are ten attendees in this meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: John is the chair of today's meeting.
options: John is the chair of today's meeting.
John is the host of today's meeting.
She is the chair of today's meeting.
John is the boss of today's meeting.
questions.correct_answer: John is the chair of today's meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to schedule a meeting for next week.
options: We need to schedule a meeting for next week.
We need to cancel a meeting for next week.
We need to postpone a meeting for next week.
We need to schedule the meeting for next week.
questions.correct_answer: We need to schedule a meeting for next week.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The meeting is postponed to Friday.
options: The meeting is postponed to Friday.
The meeting is scheduled to Friday.
The meeting is cancelled to Friday.
The meeting is moved to Friday.
questions.correct_answer: The meeting is postponed to Friday.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I can't attend the meeting tomorrow.
options: I can't attend the meeting tomorrow.
She can't attend the meeting tomorrow.
I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
I won't attend the meeting tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I can't attend the meeting tomorrow.
